patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — ActiveCampaign documents a broader use-case set; Kit is narrower/specialist.

Comparison thesis: General-purpose vs specialist. Choose ActiveCampaign only if your buying job matches “Email marketing automation ESP with multi-step journeys; CRM pipelines strongest on Plus+;” rather than Kit's shape. Choose Kit only if your buying job matches “Creator and newsletter ESP (formerly ConvertKit) with landing pages, automations, and digi” rather than ActiveCampaign's shape. Workflow advantage: ActiveCampaign leans lead-management, inbound-sales; Kit leans small-business-campaigns. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — ActiveCampaign documents a broader use-case set; Kit is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: ActiveCampaign is Email marketing automation ESP with multi-step journeys; CRM pipelines strongest on Plus+; contact-based pricing.; Kit is Creator and newsletter ESP (formerly ConvertKit) with landing pages, automations, and digital product selling..
- Company-size focus: ActiveCampaign (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Kit (micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: ActiveCampaign-leaning lead-management, inbound-sales, high-volume-lead-management vs Kit-leaning small-business-campaigns.
- Researched limits: ActiveCampaign — Confirm live ActiveCampaign checkout; packaging can change.; Kit — Free Newsletter plan limits automations vs Creator/Pro.

Limitations — ActiveCampaign: Confirm live ActiveCampaign checkout; packaging can change.; Kit: Free Newsletter plan limits automations vs Creator/Pro; Paid pricing scales with subscribers.

Poor-fit cases: ActiveCampaign is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Confirm live ActiveCampaign checkout; packaging can change. · Kit is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free Newsletter plan limits automations vs Creator/Pro · Avoid ActiveCampaign if you actually need Kit's motion (Creator and newsletter ESP (formerly ConvertKit) with landing pages, automations)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
